The writer's input set is the three files its source reads (A map taxonomy, B lead contract, AL vocab aliases); the checker source is pinned and was read.
All writer runs happened in isolated mirror trees under runs/; no canonical path was opened for writing.
Wall-clock mtimes are corroboration only; the pinned bytes are what the hashes bind.
